high_level_description: The image shows a person sitting on a wooden bench outdoors. The individual is wearing a white button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, paired with blue jeans that have a faded wash effect. Over the shirt, they have on a green, shiny jacket that appears to be made of a material like waxed canvas or a similar fabric. The person is accessorized with a delicate necklace featuring small, round pendants and a bracelet on their left wrist. The bench is situated in what looks like a park or a garden, as indicated by the fallen leaves scattered on the ground around the bench.
